title: We are making solid progress...
content_text:
We are making solid progress on the Q3 launch. The core features are already eighty percent complete.
That said, we have hit a few bottlenecks with the third-party integration, which could push our timeline back by a week.
I would recommend we bring in one more frontend engineer to keep us on track.
If everything goes smoothly, we should be ready for the internal demo by next Friday.
